title: OpenRTB 2.6 DurFloors
description: Allows sellers to specify price floors for video and audio creatives whose price varies based on duration.

mindur.description: Low end of a duration range. If missing, the low end is unbounded.

maxdur.description: High end of a duration range. If missing, the high end is unbounded.

bidfloor.description: Minimum bid for a given impression opportunity in this duration range, expressed in CPM.
